basic_info.description: This distinguished Victorian residence, located on a serene, tree-lined street, blends historic charm with modern sophistication. This two unit home offers four beds and three baths, spanning three levels plus a basement and tandem garage. The home features a grand triple parlor with 11-foot ceilings and three fireplaces, creating an inviting space for both entertaining and relaxation.    The architect-designed primary suite, den and kitchen showcase a refined Japanese modern aesthetic, offering a peaceful and stylish living environment. From every level, enjoy breathtaking views of downtown, with the extensive terraced garden providing an urban oasis. The property has expansion opportunity and is currently being used as a duplex.    Situated just about three blocks from two vibrant urban villages, the home offers easy access to shopping, dining and public transportation. The neighborhood is known for its tranquil, well-maintained homes, providing a peaceful retreat within the city. This residence embodies the ideal blend of timeless elegance and modern convenience, offering a truly exceptional lifestyle.
